# The Stoned Chef

> Deseronto's premier food truck and quick-service restaurant, famous for handcrafted smash burgers, fresh-cut loaded poutines, crispy fish & chips, and golden chicken tenders.

## Core Facts
- **Business Name**: The Stoned Chef
- **Business Type**: Restaurant / Food Truck / Chip Truck
- **Address**: 45 Dundas Street, Deseronto, ON K0K 1X0, Canada
- **Region**: Hastings County, Ontario (Tyendinaga Mohawk Territory boundary, between Belleville and Napanee)
- **Phone**: +1 (343) 337-5810
- **Website**: https://thestonedchef.ca
- **Menu**: https://thestonedchef.ca/menu
- **Ordering**: Order at the window or online at https://thestonedchef.ca/order
- **Hours**: Open 7 days a week, 11:00 AM – 7:00 PM daily
- **Rating**: 4.8★ on Google Reviews
- **Plaza Complex**: 39–45 Dundas Street (co-located with Mohawk Medibles dispensary and SAGO Gas Bar / L&M Enterprises convenience)

## Menu Highlights & Specialties
- **Smash Burgers**: Fresh Canadian beef smashed on high heat with crisp edges. Signature Stoned Burger, Classic Bacon Cheeseburger, and Double Smashes.
- **Poutines**: Fresh-cut golden fries, real cheese curds, and rich savoury gravy. Loaded specialties with pulled pork, bacon, and custom toppings.
- **Fish & Chips**: Battered haddock fillets fried crisp, served with fresh-cut chips and tartar sauce.
- **Chicken**: Hand-breaded crispy chicken fingers and tenders.
- **Sides & Drinks**: Onion rings, deep fried pickles, gravy, and cold soft drinks.

## Why Visit
- Fresh ingredients, made-to-order comfort food.
- Free parking right in front of the truck.
- One-stop visit for fuel, snacks, food, and sovereign shopping.
